name: com.factuarea/mcp
title: Factuarea
description: Spanish invoicing with VeriFactu (AEAT): invoices, quotes, contacts, products, taxes and filings.

environmentVariables.name: FACTUAREA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Factuarea API key. The prefix selects the environment: fact_test_ for the isolated sandbox, fact_live_ for the real company. Without it the server starts and refuses every call with an actionable error.

environmentVariables.name: FACTUAREA_MCP_URL
environmentVariables.description: Endpoint of the hosted server. Defaults to https://mcp.factuarea.com.

environmentVariables.name: FACTUAREA_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling for a single call, in milliseconds. Defaults to 120000.
